name: background_set
description: Set a slide's background (PLAN 2.148): one of the theme's shader presets filling the canvas behind everything on `state`'s slide, entering in the slide's first state and kept to its slide, each shader that filled the canvas before taken away, and each text too faint to read over it set in the theme's color that reads there, as a re-theme sets it. Without `preset`, the slide's background is taken away. One patch, refused as `deck_patch` refuses one, reported as `deck_patch` reports one. Backgrounds stay off a slide that shows a chart or a table (W311): data reads against a plain surface.

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

state.description: A state of the slide: the background enters in the slide's first state and stays on it.

preset.description:
One of the theme's shader presets (`shaders.presets`: `backdrop`, `aurora`, `texture`,
`haze`, `lagoon`, `sweep`, `dust` in the themes that ship). Without it, the slide's
background is taken away.

dry_run.description: Say what would change, and write nothing.

oneOf.description:
Put `value` at `path`: a member of an object (one already there is replaced, in its
place), or an item of an array, at an index or at its end (`-`).
Replace what is at `path`, which must be there.

`remove` at `from`, then `add` at `path`. A member moved within its object keeps its
place: a rename.
Fail the patch unless `path` holds `value` (numbers equal by value: 1 is 1.0).

Pointer.description:
A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901): empty, the whole document, or `/`-separated tokens, `~1` for a
`/` and `~0` for a `~` inside one.

Finding.description: One lint finding, shaped for agents: a code, a JSON pointer, and (when safe) a fix.

file.description: The bundle file `path` points into, when it is not `deck.json` (a theme file).

format.description: The format the deck was laid out in (`"9:16"`), when it is not the deck's own.

fix.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that resolves the finding. Only safe, non-content fixes.

refresh.description:
The data source to fetch again, where what resolves the finding is a fetch, which no patch
makes (W428, ADR-0030): the source's name, without its `@`.

Restated.description:
A beat whose claim its slide said before an edit and says no more: what it claimed, what the
slide says now, and the patch that sets the claim to it.

state.description: The state of the beat's slide whose words `says` are, or, with none, the beat's first.

path.description: Where the claim is, as a JSON pointer.

claim.description: The claim, as the beat still says it.

says.description:
What the slide says now: the words of the text that said the claim, in the state it said
it in, else the last that shows it; none where every such text was taken away.

fix.description:
The patch that sets the claim to what the slide says, where it says something: a `test`
of the old claim, then a `replace`.

applied.description: Whether the deck was written: not under a dry run, nor when the patch was refused.

patch.description: The patch as RFC 6902, in order.

added.description: What `validate` and `lint` find after the patch that they did not before.

removed.description: What they found before that they do not after.

errors.description: The findings that are errors, after.

states.description:
The states it changes, by id: each whose nodes, resolved with the deck's overrides,
or whose layout, transition, choreography, hold, notes, or slide number and footer are
not as they were, and each it adds. None when it is refused.

restated.description:
Each beat whose claim its slide said before the patch and says no more, with the patch
that sets the claim to what the slide says now (lift-up FUNC-2). Left out when none; not
worked out for an edit as it is typed, which an editor asks of the whole burst.
